speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. To understand the nature of your hand tremors and recent memory issues, could you please describe when these symptoms first started and if they occur on both sides of your body?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description. Could you clarify if your hand tremors occur at rest or only when you are trying to perform an action, like holding a cup? Also, have you noticed any stiffness in your arms or legs, or a feeling of slowness when moving?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Resting tremor worse on the left hand. I also have Soft speech, Reduced facial expressions, Memory decline, Difficulty in managing finances. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Iron deficiency anemia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's Disease.

While I have noted your history of a resting tremor, soft speech, reduced facial expressions, and memory decline, the previous suggestion of iron deficiency anemia is inconsistent with your motor symptoms. Would you agree to a DaTscan or a referral for a neurology specialist to confirm this diagnosis?
